messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, including row and column edge stops. Focus movement preserves the remembered Tab stop and leaves card activation unchanged.

All 138 unit tests and 76 browser tests passed, including keyboard play, snapshots, and pointer and touch journeys. The repository-wide formatting check reports 13 existing files outside this change; the changed files are formatted.
